environment: Chromium SwiftShader, 640x480 pixel ratio 1; elapsed driver queries are not hardware GPU execution.
method: Fresh runtime per case; two reversed-order trials for large/infinite with distant layers, one pair for other cases and disabled control. Settle queues then 60 warmup frames. Stationary180, movement phases60 each, stopped-late180. Fixed 0.06/0.18/0.6 m per frame. Rapid turn/teleport and stopped-late are deliberately separate from stationary LOD comparison. Stop phase pauses new detailed work for 30 frames while proxies prepare, then restores the existing work budget. GC/upload bytes unmeasured.
